scope: Descriptive raw-indexed voltage-ramp comparison for one selected cell; no independent-sample inference
limits: Same bin index is compared across files; spatial alignment and source smoothing/baseline protocol are not reconstructed here.
The 100 bins and two inductions are repeated observations of one cell, not biological replicates; no p-value is computed.
A similar later voltage ramp is not a SAN phase reference, eligibility trace, differential-dissipation measure, or independently designed matched probe.
A profile difference is not assigned to learning, drift, noise, or induction without the source experiment's controls.
